name: Cult of Malac — the Mountain of Fire

identity.symbol: A sun-disk pendant — hammered copper, no detail
identity.public_perception: The new faith. Draws the young. Seen as vital by adherents, dangerous by the Orthodox and Bandua faithful, and vaguely unsettling by those with no faction.

goals.primary: Formal recognition; Rakhmoth's theology accepted as the true Malac faith.
secondary: End the seasonal raids on humanoid territories
Establish Telvari as a permanent Schismatic site
Grow the pilgrimage route to the Mountain of Fire
goals.hidden_agenda: Unknowingly serving fire elemental interests. The Mountain of Fire is a fire elemental site. Pilgrims who go there are being used. Neither Rakhmoth nor Savar understands this.

philosophy.summary: The sun is Malac's true face. The Mountain of Fire (the Irkali, east of Imazuran) is where Malac is most present. Pilgrimage and self-sacrifice there are the highest rite. Humanoid tolerance is correct; seasonal raids are an offense against Malac's broader creation.
methods: Pilgrimage to the Mountain of Fire
Preaching against seasonal raids in the market
limits: Will not directly attack the Orthodox — yet
Will not acknowledge fire elemental influence — they are unaware of it

position.territory: House of the Mountain of Fire (Dravesa); Telvari steading (north of Dravesa); the Mountain of Fire itself (east of Imazuran).
position.active_since: A generation ago, when Rakhmoth first preached.

alliances.nature: Unknown to the Schismatics. The fire elementals are shaping the cult's theology and using the Mountain of Fire as a foothold on Airth.

rivals.nature: The schism. The Schismatics have taken most of the young Orthodox congregation.
Direct opposition. Schismatic humanoid-tolerance preaching is undermining steading participation in the seasonal raids.

needs: Formal civic recognition from Warden Keln
Telvari secured as a permanent site
provides: Community for the young and alienated
Letters of introduction for the Mountain of Fire pilgrimage

rakhmoth.name: Rakhmoth
rakhmoth.role: Prophet and founder. Currently at the Mountain of Fire. Arriving for Midsummer (~3 weeks).
rakhmoth.notes: A genuine believer. More dangerous than Savar. His revelation came from fire elemental influence, which he does not know.

savar.name: Savar
savar.role: Local agent and mouthpiece in Dravesa.
savar.notes: See npcs/savar.json. More deeply compromised than Rakhmoth — warm to the touch, perfect recall.

telvari.name: Telvari
telvari.role: Northern steading. Fire worship site and humanoid-human contact point.

dm_notes: The fire elemental influence is the late-game revelation. Do not name it early. Savar is the tell — warm to the touch, perfect recall, accepted Jorun Cadek's pilgrimage death as fitting. The Mountain of Fire is a fire elemental site; pilgrims who go there do not always return.
